features: CGSCC pass manager, analysis invalidation, IPO optimization pipeline
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This revert restores the older CGSCC analysis invalidation behavior by undoing a prior optimization that only invalidated analyses for modified functions. The affected IPO passes and CGSCC infrastructure are rewritten back toward broader invalidation semantics, with corresponding updates to inliner and argument-promotion/function-attribute logic so that passes no longer track per-function changed sets as aggressively. The tests are updated to reflect more conservative analysis invalidation and rerunning behavior in the new pass manager pipeline.
Mechanisms: Revert incremental analysis invalidation in CGSCC pass manager; Restore broader function-analysis invalidation semantics in IPO passes; Change attribute inference helpers from changed-function tracking to boolean change reporting; Adjust inliner and argument promotion to rely on coarser invalidation
Touched symbols: incorporateNewSCCRange; ArgumentPromotionPass::run; FunctionAttrs.cpp helpers (addReadAttrs, addArgumentReturnedAttrs, addArgumentAttrs, addNoAliasAttrs, addNonNullAttrs, addNoRecurseAttrs, addNoReturnAttrs, addWillReturn, addNoSyncAttr, deriveAttrsInPostOrder); AttributeInferer::run; PostOrderFunctionAttrsPass::run; InlinerPass::run; runImpl; FunctionAnalysisManagerCGSCCProxy
Risk relevance: Changes analysis invalidation and preservation behavior in CGSCC/IPO pipelines, which can expose stale-analysis bugs or alter optimization ordering; Touches inliner and function-attribute inference, both of which can influence downstream simplification and codegen decisions; Could indirectly affect optimization-triggered crashes by changing when analyses are recomputed versus reused
Build risk: Large refactor of pass-manager bookkeeping and helper return types, increasing compile-time and integration risk; Updates multiple optimization tests and pipeline expectation files, indicating observable behavior changes in debug-pass-manager output; Deletes a dedicated invalidation test and rewrites several analysis-preservation expectations
